name: Volatile Memory: Severed
source:
A haircut that devolves into reminiscing about a years-gone past between young Artemis and her stand-in mother, Maia.

[From [url=https://vaguelygalaxy.itch.io/volatile-memory-severed]Itch.io[/url]]
